address: 50, 18-19 Thanon Pan, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_zh: 必點：泰式炒河粉、青咖喱。傳統曼谷小館，用料實在份量大，在地人下班最愛的宵夜據點，坐在騎樓邊吃邊看街景才夠道地。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

name_zh: The Warehouse Bangkok 倉庫餐廳
description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok.
description_zh: 必點：手工漢堡、自釀啤酒。舊倉庫改建的餐酒館，工業風格濃厚，是在地年輕人最愛的聚集地。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for To food lovers and Decision.
description_zh: 必點：咖哩蟹、青木瓜沙拉。曼谷在地人氣食堂，每道菜都用料實在，咖哩香氣直接嗆鼻，一吃就停不下來。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for The manager.
description_zh: 必點：經理人特製餐點。INDDEE的經理親自掌廚，用心打造每一道菜色，是這間店最獨特的靈魂。來這裡就是為了吃經理的手藝。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Thai Tea and Coffee this time.
description_zh: 必點：泰式奶茶、咖啡。ABBA是曼谷咖啡愛好者的私房去處，泰奶濃郁香醇，咖啡豆選得講究，每一杯都能喝出用心。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

name_en: ARUN Riverside Bangkok (อรุณริเวอร์ไซด์)
name_zh: ARUN Riverside Bangkok (อรุณริเวอร์ไซด์)
description_en: A mid-range, highly praised hotel in Bangkok. Known for Rooftop View.
description_zh: 必點：河畔屋頂景觀。站在高處俯瞰湄南河夜景，曼谷的燈火在腳下閃爍。這間飯店就是為了這道景色而生。
address: 87, 89 Thanon Maha Rat, พระบรมมหาราชวัง, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Bright rooms & suites in an elegant hotel with an elegant rooftop restaurant offering river views.
description_zh: 必點：屋頂景觀。Riva Arun 房間寬敞雅致，頂樓餐廳面河而設，適合黃昏時分來杯飲品，看湄南河夜景點燈。
address: 392, 25-28 Thanon Maha Rat, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Sushi and Steak.
description_zh: 必點：壽司、牛排。曼谷少見的日式牛排融合壽司吧，新鮮漁貨和熟成牛肉在同一張檯上享受，用餐氛圍輕鬆自在。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Papaya Salad.
description_zh: 必點：青木瓜沙拉。曼谷最道地的木瓜沙拉小館，酸辣比例拿捏得恰到好處，每天現做現賣，在地人都來這裡。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded restaurant in Bangkok. Known for To order no spicy level and All every menu.
description_zh: 必點：所有菜色均可選擇不辣等級。Phed Phed 擅長泰式經典料理，每道菜都能客製化辣度，讓怕辣的旅客也能盡情享受道地風味。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok.
description_zh: 必點：炸雞、芒果糯米飯。曼谷年輕人的最愛，平價又道地的泰式小食天堂，夜晚人氣爆棚。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for For big families and Places to relax.
description_zh: 必點：咖啡、放鬆的氛圍。古城區手工烘焙坊，寬敞舒適適合大家庭聚聚，啜飲一杯精心烘焙的咖啡，感受曼谷老城的悠閒步調。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok.
description_zh: 必點：松露漢堡、起司牛肋。隱身巷弄的精緻漢堡專門店，每一口都是用心調配的肉汁與香氣，是曼谷漢堡控的私房口袋名單。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Mango Sticky Rice and Papaya Salad.
description_zh: 必點：芒果糯米飯、青木瓜沙律。道地泰菜小館，芒果選得甜，糯米火候恰到好處，一口咬下去整個曼谷的滋味都在裡面。
address: 36/1 Soi Sukhumvit 23, คลองเตย Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Vietnamese food here and Banh mi.
description_zh: 必點：越南法國麵包、越南菜。Ari區隱藏的越南料理小店，麵包脆香、餡料新鮮，咬下去汁液四溢，根本是曼谷最道地的越南味。
address: 27 Phahon Yotin 5, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Live Music.
description_zh: 必點：現場音樂。Tiger Ari是曼谷隱藏的音樂酒吧，駐唱樂隊每晚帶動氣氛，啤酒配live band是在地人的夜生活必備。
address: 356 โครงการ ลาวิลล่า ชั้น3 Phahon Yothin Road, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

name_zh: Kohaku 琥珀 こはく Omakase

description_zh: 必點：握壽司、omakase套餐。東京師傅坐鎮，新鮮漁獲每日直送，在吧檯享受師傅的精湛刀工與故事。價格不菲但值得一試。

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Ramen and Sushi.
description_zh: 必點：拉麵、壽司、義大利麵。曼谷少見的多國料理餐廳，每道都用心製作，從日式到歐陸風味應有盡有。
address: No.416, 6-7, ถ. ทองหล่อ Klongton Nua, เขตวัฒนา กรุงเทพมหานคร 10110, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Dim Sum and Steak.

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Dim Sum.
description_zh: 必點：蝦餃、燒賣、叉燒包。曼谷唐人街老字號，推車點餐的傳統港式飲茶，每日現做，咬下去還燙手。
address: ใกล้ 1464 Soi Charoen Krung 44, Khwaeng Bang Rak, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand
